description: This file defines the BlockId hierarchy and related classes for identifying data blocks in Apache Spark, including various specific block types such as RDD blocks, shuffle blocks, broadcast blocks, and log blocks.

classes.name: BlockId
classes.description: Abstract sealed class representing a generic data block identifier with utility methods to determine block type.

classes.name: RDDBlockId
classes.description: Represents an RDD data block identified by rddId and splitIndex.

classes.name: ShuffleBlockId
classes.description: Represents a shuffle data block with shuffleId, mapId, and reduceId.

classes.name: ShuffleBlockBatchId
classes.description: Represents a batch of shuffle blocks with a range of reduce IDs.

classes.name: ShuffleBlockChunkId
classes.description: Represents a chunk of a shuffle block.

classes.name: ShuffleDataBlockId
classes.description: Represents a shuffle data block with data file.

classes.name: ShuffleIndexBlockId
classes.description: Represents an index file for shuffle blocks.

classes.name: ShuffleChecksumBlockId
classes.description: Represents a checksum file for shuffle blocks.

classes.name: ShufflePushBlockId
classes.description: Represents a push shuffle block.

classes.name: ShuffleMergedBlockId
classes.description: Represents a merged shuffle block.

classes.name: ShuffleMergedDataBlockId
classes.description: Represents a merged shuffle data block with appId.

classes.name: ShuffleMergedIndexBlockId
classes.description: Represents a merged shuffle index block with appId.

classes.name: ShuffleMergedMetaBlockId
classes.description: Represents metadata for merged shuffle blocks with appId.

classes.name: BroadcastBlockId
classes.description: Represents a broadcast data block.

classes.name: TaskResultBlockId
classes.description: Represents a task result data block.

classes.name: StreamBlockId
classes.description: Represents a stream input data block.

classes.name: PythonStreamBlockId
classes.description: Represents a Python stream data block.

classes.name: LogBlockType
classes.description: Enumeration of log block types, e.g., TEST, PYTHON_WORKER.

classes.name: LogBlockId
classes.description: Abstract class for log data blocks, including log time, executor ID, and log type.

classes.name: TestLogBlockId
classes.description: Test log block with timestamp and executor ID.

classes.name: PythonWorkerLogBlockId
classes.description: Python worker log block with timestamp, executor ID, session ID, and worker ID.

classes.name: TempLocalBlockId
classes.description: Temporary local data block identified by UUID.

classes.name: TempShuffleBlockId
classes.description: Temporary shuffle data block identified by UUID.

classes.name: TestBlockId
classes.description: Test purpose block identified by string ID.

classes.name: UnrecognizedBlockId
classes.description: Exception class for unrecognized block IDs.

classes.name: CacheId
classes.description: Cache data block identified by session UUID and hash.

methods.name: BlockId.apply
methods.description: Factory method to parse a string name into a specific BlockId subclass.
